source.name: Liquipedia
source.method: the Elo of every map of Counter-Strike: Global Offensive and Counter-Strike 2 in Liquipedia's S-, A- and B-Tier 5v5 events from 2012-09-21 to the end of 2025 (docs/design/counter-strike.md, "Earlier seasons")
source.conversion: rating = Elo / 25 − 2, rounded; each newcomer started at his region's level as the maps to 2025-12-31 measure it (AF 1214, ASIA 1319, CIS 1544, EU 1500, MENA 1299, NA 1339, OCE 1277, SA 1455; fitted at once with every player's own strength, Europe's at 1,500: docs/design/counter-strike.md, "Regions")
